targeting.title: n8n JSON Parameter Needs to Be Valid JSON: Fix the Body
targeting.metaTitle: n8n JSON Parameter Needs to Be Valid JSON: Fix the Body
targeting.metaDescription: Fix n8n's JSON parameter error with tested object expressions and JSON.stringify. Handle quotes, newlines, nulls, arrays, and failures on later items.
targeting.excerpt: Fix n8n's HTTP Request JSON parameter error without damaging your data. Reproduce eight edge cases, choose the right body mode, preserve types, and validate dynamic or AI-generated values before sending requests.

targeting.summary: Return an object for the complete JSON body instead of inserting unescaped text into a quoted template|Verify both JSON validity and exact values with eight cases covering quotes, backslashes, newlines, tabs, Unicode, and HTML|Preserve data types, validate the failing item, and check previous successful actions before replaying production writes
